# Avani Enterprises

An enterprise-grade technology and digital marketing agency based in Gurgaon, Haryana, India. We build high-performance web applications, automate business processes, and run high-ROI digital campaigns.

## Services

- **Web Development**: Custom web applications, corporate websites, e-commerce platforms, and API integrations using modern tech stacks (React, Node.js, Next.js).
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimization)**: Technical SEO audits, local SEO, content strategy, and enterprise keyword rankings.
- **Social Media Marketing**: Brand strategy, visual design, content calendars, and targeted Meta/LinkedIn ads.
- **Google Ads**: Hyper-targeted paid search, display network, and YouTube campaign management.
- **Digital Marketing**: Full-funnel digital strategy, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and growth marketing.
